title: Staleness Report
description: DISCOVER-stage typed artifact. Output of staleness-auditor. Assesses whether a source (paper, repo, dataset, benchmark) is current or has been superseded. The status field uses a controlled enum including SUPERSEDED. Derived mechanically by staleness.py from year + named successor.

status.description: SUPERSEDED means a named successor explicitly replaces this source

age_years.description: years since publication/release relative to audit year

successor_ref.description: ref of the work that supersedes this one (required when status=SUPERSEDED)

staleness_rationale.description: brief explanation of why this source is considered stale/superseded/current

audit_year.description: the year used as the reference point for staleness calculation
